tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Company facts for Jenesis Travel: licence, contact, WhatsApp, enquiry-led model. Call this first. If the user wants a real person, share the WhatsApp URL.

tools.name: list_journeys
tools.description: List published Jenesis journeys, residences, group programmes, and packages (including Phuket Fit). Live CMS data. Enquiry-led — not a booking inventory.

tools.name: get_journey
tools.description: Get one published journey, residence, group programme, or package by slug. Use list_journeys if the slug is unknown.

tools.name: list_faqs
tools.description: Published FAQs from the Jenesis CMS, optionally filtered by pillar or search text.

tools.name: estimate_budget
tools.description: Indicative independent USD range from the Jenesis budget calculator. Not a quote. Mid-range to ultra-luxury is what Jenesis plans.

tools.name: start_enquiry
tools.description: File a planning enquiry with Jenesis Travel. Call only after the user has stated their own name and email in the conversation and confirmed they want Jenesis to reply. Never invent or substitute contact details: an enquiry carrying a placeholder address cannot be answered and is rejected. If you do not have a real email, ask for it, or share the contact form or WhatsApp instead of calling this tool. One enquiry per email every 4 hours — do not retry if it already succeeded. This does not reserve hotels or take payment.

name.description: The traveller's own name, exactly as they gave it in the conversation. Do not invent one.

email.description: The traveller's own email address, exactly as they gave it in the conversation. This is the only way Jenesis can reply, so it must be an address they actually read. Never guess one, derive one from their name, or fill in a documentation placeholder such as an example.com address — ask the traveller for it instead.
